text_block_list.text: "O golden ship sleeping at the bottom of the sea..."
"Now is the time to unleash your power. Set forth toward uncharted territory..."

"‘To a brilliant, shining place where
no one has ever reached before—’"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh............
What was that voice just now...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A dangerous self-proclaimed god?
Or is it Golshi-chan's inner alter ego?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Still, unreached territory, huh—
Unreached... Un-reached... Ah!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I get it now...
So that's what it was...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
âIn short,
you're telling me to "Come to Eden"!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first race of the Classics,
the Satsuki Sho, is just around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I really want to get
Gold Ship to train...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WROOOOOOOOOOOOOO
OOOOOAAAAAAARRRRR!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Only strong Umamusume can reach Eden...!!
Then I've just gotta become a god...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I AM...
GOOOOOD GOLSHI!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly called out to her,
but Gold Ship had already left...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Continuing to search around the academy after that—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAA
AAAAAAHHHHHHHAAAAAA------!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wh— Who is it?!
Who dares get in the way of God Golshi...?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My, oh my.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Golshi-chan.
You're awfully energetic today too, aren't you~

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Creek, it's you, huh...?
No wonder it felt so soft..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, 'cause I'm bustin' right through!
—On the prestige of a God!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *Deep inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Take this!!!!
Rapid-Fire Axe Bomber!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABLAM!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, what an amazing trick!
Well done~. *clap clap clap*

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...!!
It did nothing... to you?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Then... how about this—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Hundred-Hit Elbow Smash!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABAAAAAM!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you can do that too?
Impressive~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a sec...
Even THAT didn't work?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then I've got no choice but to bring THAT out...
God's secret trump card—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Divine Might Unleashed: Aurora Explosive Flurry Blade!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (K-K-K-K-KA-BOOOOM!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...
...Did I do it!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you practiced so much, didn't you?
Good job, good job~. Good girl, good girl.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wha, even after all that...
it didn't do... a damn thing?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Since ancient times, all things are born of the mother...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No god can match the power of maternal affection...
Guess that's just how it is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for Eden, Gold Ship worked hard
to become a strong Umamusume, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Defeated by Super Creek!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　(To be continued)
